investigation.title: Remote Agent Creation Eval Failing: POST /api/agents Returns 409 Agent Quota Exceeded (limit is 100)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-16T04:22:53Z with an identical 409 conflict response from POST /api/agents indicating the swarm agent quota of 100 has been reached for the eval org. Because the API rejected agent creation before any agent was provisioned, zero required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) were collected, causing a complete contract gap on the remote-agent-create eval.
investigation.rootCause: The production-api swarm backend returned HTTP 409 with error code "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100" when the eval runner called POST /api/agents. This prevented agent creation from proceeding, so no agent identity, VM ID, or remote state was ever returned. The failure is localized to the POST /api/agents endpoint for the eval org's swarm quota — it is an eval infrastructure failure against the production API, not a confirmed user-facing outage, as no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
